results.name: resnet_bottleneck_chain
results.description: ResNet-style bottleneck blocks with residual additions. Shape safety of x + residual requires shape(conv_branch) == shape(x) at every block — an inductive property over block count.
results.why_ic3_wins: The invariant 'every block preserves spatial dims and channels==64' is inductive. k-induction must unroll all 3 blocks; IC3 finds the frame invariant after 1-2 frames.

results.name: rnn_shared_weight_cell
results.description: Elman RNN cell with shared weights across time steps. Hidden state shape must be preserved across any number of steps — a classic loop invariant that IC3 discovers.
results.why_ic3_wins: h2h: 256->256 is applied repeatedly with the same weight matrix. The invariant 'h has shape (batch, 256)' is trivially inductive but k-induction must unroll each application.

results.name: unet_skip_connections
results.description: U-Net encoder-decoder with skip connections at each level. Concatenation requires matching spatial dims between encoder and decoder paths — an inductive symmetry argument.
results.why_ic3_wins: Symmetric encoder-decoder with padding=1 preserves spatial dims. IC3 discovers the invariant 'spatial dims are preserved through all layers' in one frame propagation.
